title: QAOA for Layered Architecture Recovery: Feasibility, Limits, and the Role of Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2611.09744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Layered architecture recovery (LAR) reconstructs a system's architectural layers from its package dependencies, and is defined as a combinatorial optimisation problem solved with classical search. We investigate whether the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) can be applied to LAR, and with what practical limitations. We formulate LAR as a Quadratic Semi-Assignment Problem, transform it into a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimisation (QUBO) problem in which each package is penalised unless it is assigned to exactly one layer, and encode it as an Ising Hamiltonian solved by QAOA. To reach instances beyond the qubit budget of a single circuit, we also apply an impact-guided decomposition that solves the problem as a sequence of smaller sub-problems. translated_title: 用于分层架构恢复的QAOA：可行性、局限性以及分解的作用
translated_abstract: 分层架构恢复（LAR）从系统的包依赖关系中重建系统的架构层次，该问题被定义为一个使用经典搜索求解的组合优化问题。我们研究了量子近似优化算法（QAOA）能否应用于分层架构恢复，以及存在哪些实际限制。我们将LAR表述为一个二次半分配问题，将其转化为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，其中每个包如果未被恰好分配到唯一一层就会被施加惩罚，并将其编码为由QAOA求解的伊辛哈密顿量。为了处理超出单个电路量子比特预算的实例，我们还应用了一种影响引导的分解方法，将问题分解为一系列较小的子问题依次求解。我们在三个真实的Java系统（15、18和24量子比特）上评估了该方法，研究了电路深度和采样预算的影响（RQ1），以及与经典算法的比较。
tldr: 该论文首次将量子近似优化算法（QAOA）应用于分层架构恢复问题，通过将其转化为QUBO问题并采用影响引导的分解策略，在三个真实Java系统上验证了量子方法在软件架构恢复中的可行性及其实际限制。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates the feasibility and practical limitations of applying QAOA to layered architecture recovery by formulating it as a QUBO problem and employing impact-guided decomposition, evaluated on three real Java systems.
